messages:
elaine: Hey all — PR ready for final merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/83821. This changes the model fallback routing and adds a small prefetch TTL. Need one runtime + one infra + security async LGTM. Planning to merge Wed 2026-03-25 during 16:00-17:00 PST canary window (10% traffic).

 tom: @elaine grabbing a quick look now. CI is failing on two tests for me, will investigate.

 priya: I can take security review. Quick Q: does this touch auth headers or token forwarding? If so I need a short threat-model note.

 lee: runtime can review once tom gives CI status. My main concern is KV cache eviction interaction with the fallback path.

 infra-bot: CI status: 3 failed, 42 passed. failing tests: alloc_prefetch_test.py::test_eviction_retry, net_timeout_test.py::test_reconnect.

 tom: Found a flaky assert, pushed a small fix on branch: `git push origin fix/83821-ci` — retriggered CI.

 priya: If there are no auth changes, I can finish review today. @elaine can you add a one-liner in the PR description explicitly stating no token forwarding changes?

 elaine: added: "No changes to token forwarding or header ordering; fallback uses existing signed-cookie flow." Also added a short rollback/runbook snippet to the PR description and perf numbers. cc @lee: noted the KV metrics we saw in staging.

 lee: skimmed the diffs, one nit: please factor out the metric name string into a constant in metrics.ts. otherwise looks fine. I'll give full LGTM once infra confirms canary pool availability.

 sam: infra here — I can reserve canary capacity, but need the target pool name. Also confirm we want dedicated GPUs for this canary.

 elaine: Targeting pool `dedicated-gpu-rt2` in us-west-2, canary instances 4, ramp to 10% traffic. Rollback plan: immediate divert to model-variant-stable and scale down to 0.

 sam: reserving pool now, ETA ~1h. Please ping when CI is green and you've scheduled the exact merge time.

 priya: Security: adding comment — verified no header/auth surface changes. LGTM from security side.

 tom: CI green: all tests passed.

 lee: runtime LGTM after the metric constant change (minor), leaving that comment.

 sam: infra OK on quotas and targeted pool.

 elaine: thanks. I'll merge at 2026-03-25T16:15:00Z unless anyone objects.

 zach: no objections from me. go ahead.

 deploy-bot: Merge performed by @elaine at 2026-03-25T16:16:03Z. Canary rollout started (10% traffic -> dedicated-gpu-rt2). Monitor: https://monitoring.redwood/rollouts/83821

 elaine: thanks everyone :tada:
